text.card: A red giant 5,444 parsecs away, 20 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 1.79 solar masses and 19.9 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,724 K at its surface.
